step.anonymize.lead: We remove names, addresses, student numbers and health details from the answers so no one can be identified.
step.vectors.lead: The AI reads every answer once, so you can then search and group them by meaning.
step.rerank.lead: Some answers could fit more than one theme. A second, more careful AI reads those again and picks the best theme. Answers that were already clear are left alone.
step.insights.lead: The AI writes a summary per theme, with example comments and suggestions. They appear on the Overview.
step.query.lead: Type a question in plain language and see which student answers match.
